text:
Priya Shah: Heads up — final panel for the L5 infra candidate is tomorrow 11:00–12:30 PT. Need 1) scribe coverage, 2) a very short score-calibration (5–10m) immediately before debrief, and 3) confirmation on rubric weights.

Samir Patel: I can scribe the first block (11:00–11:40). @Aisha can you take the last 40? Also confirm weights: system design 40%, coding 30%, culture 20%, docs 10% — is that what we landed on?

Aisha Khan: I can take 11:40–12:30. Yep on the weights. Can we do a micro-calibration at 12:35 for 10min (right after panel) or you mean before the debrief? I prefer a 10:45 quick anchor during interview break — less schedule churn.

Priya Shah: good point — let's do a 12:35 debrief calibration (5–10m) immediately after the panel so notes are fresh. If people prefer a 10:45 anchor earlier, say so. Also quick rubric anchors would help — drop 1 example per category here if you have it.

Elena Gomez: added anchors to the rubric doc: https://docs.internal/rubrics/l5-infra (private). Quick excerpts:
- System design (40%): "Candidate proposes a 3‑component design with failure modes, latency/cost tradeoffs, and rollout strategy; shows clear scaling plan."
- Coding (30%): "Completes core algorithm, tests edge cases, explains time/space tradeoffs."
- Culture (20%): "Communicates clearly, mentorship examples, resolves tradeoffs with pragmatic bias."
- Docs (10%): "Produces a concise runbook or PR description with rollback/caveats."

Priya Shah: thanks Elena. Scribe note template (paste into meeting doc):
```
- Candidate: [name]
- Interviewers: [list]
- Scores: system / coding / culture / docs (1–5)
- Top 3 takeaways (bullets)
- Recommend: hire / strong hire / no hire / hold
```
Also reminder: use 1–5 scale, decimals allowed for averaging. Tie-breaker = hiring lead call after short sync.

Samir Patel: small logistics Q: for coding section we agreed 30m whiteboard with hints allowed (no laptop). Confirm? I can proctor hints after 15m if needed.

Aisha Khan: confirmed whiteboard 30m, hints allowed but document them in notes. Also I'll capture test cases and edge-case discussion in the scribe template.

Hiring Bot: Reminder scheduled: "Final panel debrief — L5 infra" at 12:35 PT. Recording will be available after meeting. Scribe assignments: Samir Patel (11:00–11:40), Aisha Khan (11:40–12:30). Calendar invites sent to panel.

Priya Shah: sweet — last ask: any conflicts of interest? e.g., previous manager, direct report, or worked on candidate's repo recently. If yes, flag here and we can rotate or anonymize notes.

Samir Patel: none for me.

Elena Gomez: none.

Aisha Khan: none.

Priya Shah: perfect. I'll send a final checklist to panel at 5pm today with links and the scribe template. If anyone wants the pre-session micro-calibration at 10:45 instead, speak now otherwise we'll keep the immediate post-panel 12:35 anchor. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: post-panel works for me. :+1:

Aisha Khan: post-panel ok.

Elena Gomez: post-panel ok.

Priya Shah: thanks — closing this thread, will pester again at 17:00 with the checklist.
